comparisons.B1: pre-specified interpretable price-only score: equal-weight ranks of mom121 and -vol252
comparisons.B2: B1 plus family-balanced accounting families (equal weight per FAMILY, not per feature)
comparisons.B3: Ridge on exactly the B2 features (regional_alpha_model Ridge config), walk-forward; descriptive only
comparisons.B4: investable: production select_portfolio_by_scores, <=5 names, sector cap 2, zero names when no net-of-cost edge, realistic regional costs

dataQualityGate.appliesBefore: registration of any historical (development) experiment below

checks.rule: every recovered panel is tied to the departed member by same-CIK, explicit '(Previously X)' or identical name at the switch; ticker-only matches are rejected; a reused ticker's later issuer is never joined
recovered panels are a NEW hashed input snapshot (new replay generation); replay-v16 and its manifest stay frozen
publish departed-only no-panel member-date share by year before and after recovery; no tolerance is chosen, the residual is reported
every held or ranked name whose label window crosses its last session carries cited terminal economics or is UNRESOLVED; UNRESOLVED is never zero and never the last price
every primary statistic is reported twice: unresolved dropped, and unresolved assigned the date's worst plausible outcome; a claim survives only if both readings agree in sign
results on 2013-2026 are EXPLORATORY_DEVELOPMENT_ON_OUTCOME_EXPOSED_US_HISTORY even with recovered names

routing.FULL: run development experiments on the repaired snapshot under DQ1-DQ6
routing.INSUFFICIENT: do not wait: historical results stay SURVIVOR_CONDITIONED development evidence and the program moves to prospective collection
routing.PARTIAL: run them with DQ5 bounding as the binding reading; publish which years remain unvouched

codexDepartedPriceRecovery.rule: no experiment below is registered until the recovery verdict is published and audited by dataQualityGate

experiments.baseline: B1 (and B0 for the economic reading)
experiments.calibration: REQUIRED before registration: the paired top-quintile difference is not the statistic P3 calibrated; reuse the US H63 engine on this exact statistic only
experiments.contributesToDecision: directly: it is the ranking the <=5-name selector would consume, measured where the selector cuts
experiments.dataReadiness: historical joint complete-case: 77.7% of non-financial member-dates through leverage, 55.1% once every family including reconstructed value is required (jointAttrition, which also requires earningsGrowth; the exact US-MF-1 set is not separately measured); 2013 is mostly dark; prospectively blocked on total assets and the daily price ledger
decisionReadings: B4 vs B0 after costs (descriptive on history; primary only prospectively)
permutation null of B2 within the same construction (selection_null)
names held, turnover split into replaced vs retargeted, cost drag

estimatedCost.calibration: ~1 h on 4 workers (US H63 P3 measured ~58 min)
estimatedCost.featureBuild: ESTIMATE ~40-45 min single-threaded for all 715 weekly dates (MEASURED: 55 sample dates took 4.4-4.6 min, ~1.5 min of it loading; per-date part scaled 13x)

experiments.falsification: upper one-sided 95% bound <= 0 under either DQ5 reading -> the accounting families do not improve the selection margin on this sample

horizon.why: the only US horizon with a calibrated inference geometry (US_H63_INFERENCE_CALIBRATION_V1)

experiments.hypothesis: Within S&P 500 non-financials, a fixed equal-weight composite of FAMILY representatives (cash quality, accrual profitability, investment [-asset growth], leverage [-D/E], value [earnings yield, reconstructed]) improves the H63 ordering of names beyond price-only information (B1), at the margin a <=5-name selector uses
experiments.method: linear in returns, so calendar-time attribution + CT_SN; one-sided 95%
experiments.name: Family-balanced multifactor selection value
experiments.primaryOutcome: mean over weekly signal dates of the top-quintile-minus-universe H63 excess of the B2 composite MINUS the same for B1, within sector, paired by date (return units)
experiments.whyNewInformation: cash quality, investment and leverage were never related to US outcomes; asset growth is 82% unique of the other families; the 31-feature model had no value or investment

experiments.calibration: DONE for 150-330 names/date; 331-371 is uncalibrated and needs an explicit owner disposition
experiments.contributesToDecision: indirectly: decides whether the cash family enters US-MF-1's composite on its own merit
experiments.dataReadiness: historical 83.4% primary-complete, median 285 names/date; prospectively blocked on total assets
experiments.dataRecoveryDependency: P4-v1 is frozen on replay-v16; a repaired snapshot would be a NEW version (P4-v2), never an edit of P4-v1
experiments.falsification: development upper bound <= 0 -> abandon before prospective collection
experiments.hypothesis: OCF/assets residualised on sector, size, momentum, volatility and accrual profitability orders H63 SPY-relative returns
experiments.name: Cash-confirmed profitability H63 (existing P4 lineage)

resumeRule.FULL_or_PARTIAL_recovery: owner chooses: run P4-v1 as frozen, OR retire it unexecuted and register P4-v2 = identical definitions + repaired snapshot + DQ gate; never both (two looks at one hypothesis)
resumeRule.INSUFFICIENT_recovery: run P4-v1 as frozen (its survivorship is disclosed; waiting buys nothing)

experiments.whyNewInformation: never outcome-exposed in the US; but 70% of its rank is carried by the other families, so only the cash-vs-accrual residual is at stake

experiments.calibration: covered by P3 only if names/date and control structure match the calibrated geometry; otherwise a targeted calibration
experiments.contributesToDecision: supplies a candidate family for US-MF-1; standalone it is discovery only
experiments.dataReadiness: historical 92.0% of non-financial member-dates; prospectively blocked on total assets (same blocker as US-MF-2)
experiments.dataRecoveryDependency: dataQualityGate routing; acquisitions inflate asset growth, and acquired companies are exactly the departed names
experiments.falsification: upper bound <= 0 under either DQ5 reading
experiments.hypothesis: Firms growing assets fastest earn lower subsequent H63 SPY-relative returns than peers, beyond profitability, size and momentum
experiments.name: Investment and payout policy (asset growth, capex intensity, distributions)
experiments.primaryOutcome: return-unit residual-weighted spread of -assetGrowthPct, the statistic form P3 calibrated
experiments.whyNewInformation: assetGrowthPct is the most distinct computable characteristic measured (unique share 0.82, own-family R2 with capex 0.005) and was never in any US study

layers.layer1: factor discovery: raw IC (descriptive), partial rank association (descriptive), return-unit residual spread (primary), never pooled
layers.layer2: selection: expected excess from expanding calibration, uncertainty, <=5 names, zero allowed, sector/liquidity caps, costs, SPY/QQQ comparison

notBuiltYet: any new production model or selector
EV/EBITDA, gross profitability, ROIC (no derivation or source)

ownerDecisions.decision: Which Codex recovery verdict triggers which route in dataQualityGate.routing (accept or amend the routing)
P4: run P4-v1 as frozen, or retire it unexecuted for a P4-v2 on the repaired snapshot (US-MF-2.resumeRule)
P4 upper geometry 331-371 names/date: require calibration or accept exploratory extrapolation
Primary universe: S&P 500 non-financials (recommended) vs a broader liquid universe (needs new price, identity and fundamentals collection)
Approve the persistent US daily price ledger and a total-assets source decision; without both, no US prospective evidence can accrue
Authorize the targeted calibration of the US-MF-1 statistic (synthetic only; no outcome read)

researchBudget.multiplicity: Holm across the three primary claims if all are executed; descriptive readings carry no verdict

universeRecommendation.notAutomatic: a broader universe adds names, not independent dates: the four-factor audit's per-date IC variance is mostly common-factor exposure, so effective dates stay ~27 at H126
universeRecommendation.primary: dated S&P 500 snapshot members, Financials and Real Estate excluded for accounting families, priced and identity-verified

value.rule: latest S&P 500 snapshot strictly before each of the weekly signal dates

universeRecommendation.why: the only US universe with dated membership, PIT fundamentals for ~all members and (after recovery) bounded survivorship; a concentrated personal book needs liquid names
